explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/94: 'Lefmann and Thiele [LeTh95] prove a stronger version of this question, that Σ_i f(u_i)² ≪ n³ under the weaker assumption that no three points are on a line.' The Lean statement: ∃ C > 0 such that every finite P ⊂ ℝ² with NonTrilinear P satisfies Σ_{u ∈ distanceSet P} (distanceMultiplicity P u)² ≤ C·|P|³, where distanceMultiplicity counts unordered pairs at distance u (the file's test confirms Σ f(u) = C(n,2)). Faithful.
